records.claim: Two studies reported an increased chance of preterm delivery (birth before week 37) and low birth weights (weighing less than 5 pounds, 8 ounces [2500 grams] at birth) when haloperidol was taken during pregnancy. However, the authors of both studies reported they did not have information on other important factors that could be linked to low birth weight and/or preterm delivery. It is not known if haloperidol, other medications, mental health conditions, or other factors increased the chance for these problems.
records.source_section: Does taking haloperidol in pregnancy increase the chance of other pregnancy-related problems?
